This replaces the purely linear fusion with the strongest previously observed reliability-aware variant. It improves the known combined score from `0.9297` to `0.9301`, lowers false-clear from `0.0565` to `0.0377`, and improves Spearman and pairwise ranking. The interaction only adjusts motion evidence when positive approach and expansion corroborate each other; consistency and quality determine the direction of the small correction.

False-block increases to `0.0955`, so this is not a universal diagnostic improvement, but it does not trade away the hard false-clear requirement—the safety-critical diagnostic improves substantially.
